meta.name: re-engagement
meta.description: Writes re-engagement emails to revive cold or lost leads. Use when the user asks to "re-engage", "reactivate", "closed-lost email", "win back", "reconnect with old leads", "ramp re-engagement", "no-show follow-up", or needs to email prospects who went dark weeks/months ago. Also triggers on "revive dead leads", "lost deal email", "they ghosted me". Do NOT use for follow-ups within an active sequence (use follow-up skill), first-touch emails, or deliverability questions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 唤醒沉睡客户，发送重新激活邮件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要重新联系已沉默的潜在客户
copy.tagline_en: Revive cold leads with re-engagement emails
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to reconnect with prospects who have gone cold

howto.what: Claude 会编写重新接触邮件，用于恢复冷线索、已关闭商机和长期未联系的潜在客户。邮件采用“否”导向的提问方式，并引用上次接触后的新变化。
howto.when: 当你说出“re-engage”、“reactivate”、“closed-lost email”等关键词，或要求给失联数周/月的潜在客户发邮件时触发。不用于活跃序列跟进或首次接触。

say.text: 帮我写一封重新接触冷线索的邮件，上次沟通是三个月前。
say.note: Claude 会生成一封带“否”导向问题的重新接触邮件。

say.text: 给那个丢失的商机写封激活邮件，提到他之前说的顾虑。
say.note: Claude 会引用原始异议并说明新变化。

say.text: 写一封重新联系旧客户的邮件，换个新角度。
say.note: Claude 会基于新触发点写一封软性号召的邮件。

howto.what_en: Claude writes re-engagement emails to revive cold leads, closed-lost deals, and long-absent prospects. Emails use 'no-oriented' questions and reference what changed since last contact.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 're-engage', 'reactivate', 'closed-lost email', or ask to email prospects who went dark weeks/months ago. Not for active sequences or first-touch.

say_en.text: Write a re-engagement email for a cold lead we last contacted 3 months ago.
say_en.note: Claude generates a no-oriented question email.

say_en.text: Write a reactivation email for that lost deal, referencing their earlier objection.
say_en.note: Claude cites the original blocker and new developments.

say_en.text: Write a re-engagement email to an old contact from a new angle.
say_en.note: Claude drafts a soft CTA email based on a fresh trigger.
